Inclusion Criteria:
  -  histologically confirmed head  [OR] and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC)
  -  WHO performance status 0-2
  -  clinical stage III patients with bulky T3 primary  [OR] +/- neck metastasis
  -  all stage IV patients
  -  referral to definitive radiotherapy  [OR] or chemoradiotherapy  [OR] or multimodality treatment
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  patients who are not able to sign written informed consent
